title: Three-pass clone in load_messages_for_chat when single move pass is possible
description: kith-tui/src/event.rs:434-436 iterates entries three times, cloning String fields on each pass. entries is a Vec<MessageEntry> consumed immediately after, so a single into_iter() pass moving fields avoids 3×N String clones. At the 50-message cap this is not a hot-path bottleneck, but the named MessageEntry struct introduced by this commit makes the move version natural — it is strictly better than the current three-pass clone.
